### Scope dungeon_floor

Ids 1 to 86. A data file reaches each table below as `dungeon_floor.<id>.<name>.<record>` and not by its own name (data patches spec §6.2).

A floor, by current_floor_id (FLINIT's branches: 71 base floors 1..74, 81 and 82 in $1$FLINIT, 86 in $2$FLINIT). FIELD walks the FLINIT chain G[0xf45dcd] on every map-block entry (FIELD@0x399); a branch writes its floor's slots and the count, and clears nothing. A load does not rerun it (INIT2@0x2c5..0x2f6).

| name | table |
|---|---|
| object | floor_object |

### Scope place

Ids 1 to 20. A data file reaches each table below as `place.<id>.<name>.<record>` and not by its own name (data patches spec §6.2).

A town place, by town_current_place_id (a BLINIT building id; the per-place arrays hold 100, and the game's places are 1 to 19, with 20, the arena, in the second append). SETORNDATA clears these tables and fills them from the ORINIT chain for the place in play each time TOWN opens a place.

| name | table |
|---|---|
| spot | town_spot |

| `0x0` | system_mode | high | investigation | SYSTEM4's mode loop (SYSTEM4@0x2de..0x6be): 1 a scene pass, 2 TOWN (@0x673), 3 FIELD, the dungeon (@0x687), 4 BTL (@0x69b), 5 DEAL (@0x6af); any other value shows 不正な実行モード and asks to exit (@0x6b5). A screen hands the turn to a scene by setting 1: SCJUMP's rules, the map events (MPEV011@0x815), TOWN@0x1423, BTL@0x50f, GAMESTART@0x139e. TOWN@0x13b0 sets 5. Saved. Values: 1 Scene, 2 Town, 3 Dungeon, 4 Battle, 5 Deal. |

## story-flag

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0xee7` | scene_played_flags | high | investigation | Played scenes and the game's other event flags, by number: each scene's branch sets its cell to 1 as it starts (1350 of 1362 branches set G[0xee7 + their number] first; SC0000@0xdfe). SCJUMP's rules test them most (1874 of 2579 tests, 483 cells). Numbers SCINIT has no scene for are event flags: 7001 to 7133 and 8051 to 8999, which scenes, map events and the CLOSE hook set (SC1000, MPEV702, CLOSE …), and which OPENFACT and RECEIPT set from FAINIT's and QUINIT's tables, where a flag is named by its number + 1 (OPENFACT@0x2ec..0x301, RECEIPT@0x889..0x89e); QUEST and TUTORIAL test them the same way (QUEST@0xbce..0xbe7, TUTORIAL@0x5ab..0x5d6). Saved. |
| `0x1e8a` | ending_scene_played | high | investigation | Scene 4003's played cell (scene_played_flags[4003]), ▼G4003 シュヴェルトライテ戦後, the scene that plays ED.BIN (SC4000@0x139c1 sets it; SC4000@0x19ae9 calls ED). 405 of SCJUMP's 419 rules and all 17 of $1$SCJUMP and $2$SCJUMP ask that it is not 1, and four context 1 rules ask that it is: the epilogues 103 (アビルースエンド), 104 (エピローグ) and 105 (ローレンエピローグ), each behind its own flag, 7100 to 7102, that scenes 3715, 3915 and 4002 set, and 101 (リンシャ＆カウラ) when none of the three is set (SC3710@0x55de, SC3910@0x186fb, SC4000@0x120b5; SCJUMP@0xec8..0x1071). So once the ending has played only the epilogues and the scenes behind them are offered. Saved. |
| `0xc5377` | enemy_book_flags | high | investigation | Saved, and kept in the shared profile: 1 for each character id met as an enemy, set when SETEN first builds its battler (SETEN@0x5b..0x6e). INFO counts them over the characters CHINIT lists in G[0x1ef7fa] (INFO@0x97c..0x9ca); INFOEN shows an unmet one as ？？？？ (INFOEN@0xb35). |
| `0xcf216` | special_encounter_states | high | investigation | Saved, by ELINIT id: bit 0 met (the player chose 待ち構える, FIELD@0x3ca0), bit 1 beaten (BTL@0x2c6, when the battle's result G[0xc20ad] is 0). A beaten encounter is not offered again (FIELD@0x411e..0x4133). Values: 1 Met, 2 Beaten, 3 Met and beaten. |

| `GS 0x348` | chapter_label | high | investigation | The chapter's number as text, 序章 to 終章: the chapter's opening scene sets it as it starts (SC0000@0xe03 序章, SC0010@0xe03 第一章 … SC0100@0xe07 終章; scenes 0, 10, 20 … 100). SAVE@0xf62 copies it into a slot's caption. Saved. |

## ui-toggle

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GS 0x34b` | message_font_name | high | investigation | The message font, ＭＳ 明朝 by default (INITCONFIG2@0x0). SYSTEM4@0x2a5 sets it with set-font; CHECKCONFIG@0x0..0x18 puts ＭＳ 明朝 back when it is not installed. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `GS 0x34c` | ui_font_name | high | investigation | The screens' font, ＭＳ ゴシック by default (INITCONFIG2@0x8); CHECKCONFIG@0x1b..0x33 puts ＭＳ ゴシック back when it is not installed. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0xecc` | confirm_save_load | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG1@0x60). While it is above 0, SAVE asks ロードしますか？ or セーブしますか？ before it loads or saves (SAVE@0xbfa). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0xed3` | adv_window_shown | high | investigation | Saved. 1 while the message window is shown: adv_hide_window_handler clears it, adv_show_window_handler sets it, draw_message_window draws only while it is set (mods/ladea-base/oms/adv.oms). |
| `0xed5` | adv_button_bar_state | high | investigation | Saved. The message window's button bar: 1 collapsed, 2 expanded; expand_button_bar sets 2, register_adv_hotspots registers the quick save, load, auto, read-skip and skip buttons only at 2 (mods/ladea-base/oms/adv.oms). Values: 1 Collapsed, 2 Expanded. |
| `0xed6` | adv_button_bar_pinned | high | investigation | Saved. The pin button: 1 keeps the button bar open, so the hotspot that collapses it is not registered (adv.oms: the pin's click toggles it). |
| `0x365d` | voice_mute_switches | high | investigation | One switch per voice setting; 1 mutes it: a page clears its voice while the speaker's setting's switch is set (SC0000@0xff2, the prelude's line template). INITCONFIG4@0x0 clears them at once (copy-to-global), the CONFIG screen's voice page sets 0 or 1 (CONFIG2@0x111a), and HISTORY and the screens read them. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x3b1c` | scene_over_map | high | investigation | 1 while the scene plays over the map: the scene pass then erases only the ADV range G 0x1d8a8..0x29810 instead of every retained object and the black backdrop (SYSTEM4@0x34d..0x360, @0x524). A map event copies scene_on_map_flags[scene] into it, and into G[0xc09f35] (MPEV011@0x82e..0x83a); BTL clears it (BTL@0x13). INIT2@0x2c5 reads it on a load, to rebuild the dungeon (SETMAPDATA, SETMAPTEX, SETFLOORTEX, DRAWCH, when G[0x4dd6f] is set) or the town (SETORNDATA, SETTOWNTEX, SETESTTEX) under the scene. Saved. |
| `0x6e41` | joystick_buttons | high | investigation | The eight joystick buttons SYSTEM4 maps (map-joystick-button 0..7, SYSTEM4@0x217..0x23a), INITCONFIG5's inline array by default (INITCONFIG5@0x0); CONFIG3 changes them. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e57` | confirm_commands | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG1@0x68). While it is set, a command asks first: 脱出する (FIELD@0x1725) and タイトル画面に戻りますか？ (SAVE@0xa01). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e5a` | autosave_off | high | investigation | 0 by default (INITCONFIG1@0x8). TOWN autosaves (its comment オートセーブ実行, TOWN@0x41d) only while it is 0 (TOWN@0x408). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e5b` | wheel_turns_pages | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG1@0x0). While it is set, a list turns its pages with the mouse's horizontal wheel (consume-mouse-hwheel-delta, ALCHEMY@0x38d, BREED@0x3ec; 27 scripts). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e5e` | field_frame_rate | med | investigation | 60 by default (INITCONFIG1@0x28): the field's frames per second. CARRY ticks every 1000 / G[0x6e5e] ms (CARRY@0x37c), DRAWWALK moves 60 / G[0x6e5e] steps a frame (DRAWWALK@0x182); FIELD, DRAWWALK2 and MOVESKIN read it too. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e65` | message_window_colour | high | investigation | 0 by default (INITCONFIG2@0x18). The message window's colour: a scene draws the window with it (gfx-draw-color 0x1e460 0 alpha G[0x6e65], $1$SC5000@0x1989), and so do BUNKI (BUNKI@0x6b9), HISTORY and CALLBACK_LOAD. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e66` | voice_continues_past_page | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG3@0x0). While it is 0, a page's end stops voices 0 and 1 (stop-voice, $1$SC5000@0x2589..0x259a): the voice stops when the page turns. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x6e67` | speaker_text_colour_mode | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG2@0x10); the CONFIG screen's first page sets it (CONFIG1@0x130a). 1: the text's effect colour is the speaker's voice_name_colors entry (CHECKCONFIG@0x52..0xdf, and every scene's copy of it); -1: white text with no effect (CHECKCONFIG@0xe7..0x106); any other value keeps the default 0x3a3a3a. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. Values: -1 White, no effect, 1 Speaker's colour. |
| `0x6e68` | voice_name_colors | high | investigation | One name colour per voice setting: CVINIT's voice_setting_name_colors, or -1 where that is 0 (INITCONFIG4@0x14..0x68); INIT2@0x23e..0x2a2 fills a -1 again when CVINIT has a colour, the appends' settings included. CHECKCONFIG@0xc3 makes the speaker's the text's effect colour while speaker_text_colour_mode is 1. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x4dd7f` | field_encounters_limited | med | investigation | Saved: set at a new game when bit 2 of G[0x6e3f] is on (GAMESTART@0xe5a..0xe68); then random battles roll only in areas of kind 1, MPINIT's G[0xc9eee9 + area] = 1 (FIELD@0x25d1..0x25ed). |
| `0xcf2f8` | replay_room_active | high | investigation | 1 for the whole replay room: HMODE@0x0 sets it, HMODE@0x1594 clears it. The scene pass then uses the replay layout (scene_window_layout 1) and sets no seen flag; the scene scripts test it in their header (SC0000@0xc3, @0x2c7). Not saved. |
| `0xf45f4f` | debug_play_active | med | investigation | 1 once TITLE's debug entries start play directly: DEBUGFIELD, DEBUGFIELD2, DEBUGFIELD3 and DEBUGTOWN set it (DEBUGTOWN@0x0). TOWN then skips the SCJUMP chain (TOWN@0xc6), TUTORIAL shows nothing (TUTORIAL@0x7), no seen flag is set, and CHECKSS skips its trigger-chance roll (CHECKSS@0x1c0). Not saved: a load clears it, so after a load on a debug entry's floor FIELD's TUTORIAL (FIELD@0xc30) shows every field tutorial the entry's unlocks call for, 30 pages after 迷宮マップ２ on both targets (run 2026-11-27). |
